source_documents.title: Polymorph crystal packing effects on charge transfer emission in the solid state

reference_evidence_units.quote: no solvent molecules were identied in the crystal lattice.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Diethyl ether vapor diffusion into chloroform; green crystals first, orange needles after days.
reference_evidence_units.statement: X-ray analysis finds no lattice solvent; green and orange forms have different packing and molecular conformers.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not a solvent inclusion mechanism; kinetic versus thermodynamic preference is an author interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: molecules in G-DMIM do not show this form of stacking.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 2 crystal packing; O-DMIM naphthalimide separation 3.73-3.75 angstrom.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Face-to-face naphthalimide stacking occurs in orange but not green crystals.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Packing does not on its own establish an excimer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the HOMO clearly resides on the N,N-dimethylaniline group while the LUMO is localised on the naphthalimide subunit
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed orbitals support donor-to-acceptor CT; orthogonal calculated geometry has a dark HOMO-LUMO transition, which gains small oscillator strength at crystal-like angles.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state/TD-DFT calculations, not direct measurement of excited-state geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with a quantum yield close to 0.02% and a maximum at 366 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM solution
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Room-temperature dilute cyclohexane; main text discusses SI solution spectrum.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solution emission is very weak; crystal emission is instead broad, peaking at 605 nm for O-DMIM and 549 nm for G-DMIM.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; do not substitute abstract chloroform context for the detailed cyclohexane experiment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The measured quantum yields are 1% and 3.5% for G-DMIM and O-DMIM, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM crystals
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Front-face illumination at 370 nm, calibrated against DCM dye in ethanol.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Estimated crystal QY is 1% green and 3.5% orange.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Method assumes all excitation light is absorbed; not integrating-sphere absolute QY.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Re-puried and recrystallized samples afforded the same results.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM purity control
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors report reproduced spectra, arguing against impurity emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not independently determine CT versus intermolecular excited-state origin.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the charge recombination is expected to be in the inverted Marcus regime and can follow radiative decay route in addition to the non-radiative one.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM crystal CT emission
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Emission-band fitting and solution electrochemistry; rigid crystal assumption.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Source assigns crystal emission to charge recombination from CT states in the Marcus inverted regime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Shared reorganization/vibrational energy constraints are modeling assumptions; no conical-intersection evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the internal reorganization energy associated with the CS state relaxation to the ground state is more than six times larger for G-DMIM than for O-DMIM
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM crystal spectral model
reference_evidence_units.conditions: CT band-shape fits, Fig. 8; common outer reorganization energy 0.400 eV.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fits give internal reorganization energies 0.33 and 0.05 eV for green and orange; source connects them to different packing relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Conditional fit, not direct structural dynamics. Printed component-contribution percentages on this page are internally inconsistent and not used.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The origin of the effect for DMIM appears to be alter- ations in rate constants for non-radiative decay.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMIM polymorph rate comparison
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors estimate about 2.6-fold higher nonradiative rate for green from fits, versus about 3.5-fold from lifetime comparison assuming similar radiative rates.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main text reports SI calculation; multiexponential decay and assumptions limit use as definitive rate separation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Polymorph packing changes CT state energy and nonradiative relaxation.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: CT excited-state character describes the same PET pathway, not an independent additional cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The central source interpretation is intramolecular photoinduced charge separation and radiative charge recombination in the crystal.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit oscillator-strength and rate-balance analysis, particularly differing nonradiative rates with similar radiative rates; model-dependent.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of intramolecular motion is established in the selected evidence; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Polymorph packing changes CT state energy and nonradiative relaxation.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: CT excited-state character describes the same PET pathway, not an independent additional cause.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The central source interpretation is intramolecular photoinduced charge separation and radiative charge recombination in the crystal.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit oscillator-strength and rate-balance analysis, particularly differing nonradiative rates with similar radiative rates; model-dependent.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
